sources.entry: SnappyMail - Simple, modern, lightweight & fast web-based email client (fork of RainLoop). AGPL-3.0 PHP
SnappyMail | Fast, modern and secure webmail client

summary.one_liner: SnappyMail is a lightweight, web-based email client (webmail) written in PHP, described as a privacy-focused fork of RainLoop Webmail.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes SnappyMail as a simple, modern, lightweight web email client and a forked and secured version of RainLoop Webmail Community edition. It states that it needs no database and offers simple installation and upgrade. The fork's listed changes include removing social and third-party integrations (Gravatar, Facebook, Google, Twitter, DropBox), dark mode, Fail2ban instructions, syslog logging of failed auth attempts, and an admin password using password_hash. It adds an advanced Sieve script editor, PGP support via OpenPGP.js v5, GnuPG and Mailvelope, and Kolab groupware support. It also removes POP3 support and several jQuery-based components. The README also includes size and performance comparisons against RainLoop.
use_cases: read and send email from a browser
web email client for Kolab groupware
how_to_run: See the project wiki for installation instructions (linked from the README at snappymail.eu)
notable: Fork of RainLoop focused on privacy and GDPR-friendliness, with social and third-party integrations removed
Dark mode, plus an option to strip message background and font colors
Supports ECDSA and EdDSA PGP keys via OpenPGP.js v5 and GnuPG
caveats: Requires PHP 7.4+ with the mbstring extension
Supports only recent browsers (Chrome 80+, Edge 80+, Firefox 78+, Opera 67+, Safari 13.1+); no Internet Explorer or Edge Legacy
The README notes the Squire editor is not yet fully compatible with CKEditor and lacks table support
